name: 冲刺跑鞋
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var targetPosition = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 2, filter: 'all' }); if (!targetPosition || targetPosition.needsTargetSelection) return targetPosition; var dx = targetPosition.x - source.x; var dy = targetPosition.y - source.y; if ((dx !== 0 && dy !== 0) || (dx === 0 && dy === 0)) return { success: false, message: '请选择正方向地格' }; var tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(item) { return item.x === targetPosition.x && item.y === targetPosition.y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props || !tile.props.walkable) return { success: false, message: '目标地格不可行走' }; var occupied = battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.instanceId !== source.instanceId && piece.x === targetPosition.x && piece.y === targetPosition.y; }); if (occupied) return { success: false, message: '目标地格已有棋子' }; if (!flow.effects.displace([{ pieceId: source.instanceId, x: targetPosition.x, y: targetPosition.y }], 'dash').success) return { success: true, message: '位移被阻挡，本次位移效果取消' }; return { success: true, message: source.name + '冲刺至(' + targetPosition.x + ',' + targetPosition.y + ')' }; }
